newsitem.title: USA: Scientific Games adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Scientific Games adopts rights plan.

text.p: Scientific Games Holdings Corp said Friday that it has adopted a shareholder rights plan designed to protect stockholder value.
The company said the plan was not adopted in response to any specific effort to acquire control of the company, and it is not aware of any such effort.

The company said the plan becomes effective with the distribution of rights to shareholders on August 11. It will enable shareholders to purchase certain of its securities when any person, other than certain excluded persons, becomes the owner or attempts to become the owner of 20 percent or more of the company's common stock.
The company said the plan is similar to those adopted at other companies.
Scientific Games provides lottery products and services, including tickets and instant and on- line lottery systems.
